title: Org proposal decisions: guard, own audit record, stale-entry digest, text rules
context: Lead-written proposals are decided in the WebUI; a cross-site POST, a forged lead audit line, a rewrite between view and click, and invisible text could all subvert a decision.
decision: Guard org writes (JSON only, no cross-site); 409 audit_unwritable; write the operator's OWN audit record; client block digest checked under the lock (409 entry_changed); stricter text rules (U+2800, private use, Zs, VS16 kept); skipped-entry status line.
consequences: Residual limits: a same-user lead can pre-plant an identical own record; an audit_pending entry stays listed until the file is fixed; Sec-Fetch-Site is absent on plain-http LAN (415 + CORS carry it).
rationale: Smallest changes that close each gap; the digest needs parity not secrecy, so a 35-line sync SHA-256 replaces crypto.subtle (absent on http).
rejected: Sending the whole block; server skipped-count endpoint; ignoring a lead reject line in countersign; HMAC provenance for own records.
